fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Deploy NAS security enhancements with NAS security mode 1-3 enforcement.
Enable IMSI blacklisting for known rogue base station IMSIs.
Configure RAN to reject NAS messages without valid IMEI/IMSI pairs.
Set NAS trace thresholds to trigger alerts for repeated 125-value events.
Implement NAS protocol validation rules for emergency/fallback triggers.
Deploy 5G NAS integrity protection with NAS security keys.
Enable RAN-based IMSI catcher detection via NAS trace anomalies.
Set NAS trace counters to flag >3 failed attachments per device.
Update core network to reject NAS messages from untrusted eNB/gNB.
Enforce NAS security mode 1-3 for all 5G NAS messages.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
